Description: Computers with unconstrained Kerberos delegation can capture TGTs of connecting users.
Remediation: Switch to constrained delegation with protocol transition.

Description: Service accounts with SPN and weak password are exposed to Kerberoasting.
Remediation: Use group managed service accounts (gMSA) with long passwords.

Description: Users with Do not require Kerberos preauthentication enabled.
Remediation: Disable the "Do not require Kerberos preauthentication" flag.

Description: Privileged accounts inactive for more than 90 days.
Remediation: Disable or remove stale privileged accounts.

Description: Domain allows RC4 for Kerberos ticket encryption.
Remediation: Disable RC4 and enforce AES on all accounts.

Description: Ticket lifetime anomalies suggest possible Golden Ticket activity.
Remediation: Reset krbtgt twice and investigate domain controller logs.
